Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner improperly resolved the ambiguity around “Kingdom of Rock” by adopting an “earliest-by-title” heuristic without artist disambiguation and prematurely asserting a 2007 date without verification. This contradicted the initial plan to confirm the correct album via authoritative sources and led to conflating different works (including a band’s 2022 release) rather than the widely recognized Magnus Karlsson’s Free Fall album from 2015, causing an incorrect comparison basis.
